title: Olfactory sensory odor receptor genotype/phenotype correlation for the investigation of specific anosmia for (E,E)-2,4-nonadienal, (2E,4E,6E)-2,4,6-nonatrienal, 3-hydroxy-4,5-dimethylfuran-2(5H)-one and (4S,4aS,8aR)-4,8a-dimethyloctahydronaphthalene-4a(2H)-ol from food and drinking water
summary: Some people cannot perceive certain smells at all or only faintly, while others perceive them very clearly. In this study, we want to investigate why this is the case. To do this, we are comparing how well individuals can recognize specific smells and whether there are any differences in their genetic makeup. Simple smell tests are conducted, and a saliva sample is taken for genetic analysis. We are conducting smell tests and additionally examining differences in the participants' genetic makeup. The results will be compared.

interventions.name:
1. Odor Threshold Determination
The perception threshold for the aroma compounds (2E,4E,6Z)-2,4,6-nonatrienal, (E,E)-2,4-nonadienal, (E,E)-2,4-decadienal, 3-hydroxy-4,5-dimethylfuran-2(5H)-one, and geosmin is determined using the 3-AFC method. The threshold is determined three times for each aroma

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Healthy individuals over 18 years of age
- Sufficient understanding of German or English to correctly perform the tests and provide informed consent.
- Willingness to participate in the sensory odor tests, the Screening 12 test (LA-13-00001, Burghart), and to provide a one-time saliva sample.
- Only men, postmenopausal women, or women using reliable contraception.
- Written informed consent after full disclosure.
Exclusion criteria:
- Known general anosmia or other diagnosed disorders of the sense of smell.
- Acute rhinitis, acute upper respiratory tract infection, or acute hay fever.
- Diseases or medications that impair the sense of smell.
- Insufficient language comprehension (German or English).
- Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
- Women of childbearing potential without reliable contraception, as the Screening 12 test (LA-13-00001, Burghart) is not to be used in pregnant women according to the manufacturer's instructions, and early pregnancy cannot be ruled out.
- Individuals with a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any of the substances used in this study.
